title: Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut with up to 50 reference images to maintain visual…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut with up to 50 reference images to maintain visual consistency across long-form scenes  
Use timestamp-based storyline control in Seedance 2.5 to time specific beats within a scene  
Extend a Seedance 2.5 generation up to 90 seconds by starting with 30s native output and applying two extensions  
Use Seedance 2.5’s Generate + Edit directly on CapCut’s timeline to iterate without leaving the editor  
Use Seedance 2.5 green screen and viewport render support to composite custom backgrounds in CapCut  
Leverage Seedance 2.5’s improved multilingual performance by prompting in your target language for better results

ja.content:

Seedance 2.5のGenerate + EditをCapCutのタイムライン上で直接使い、エディターを離れずに反復作業を行う  
Seedance 2.5のグリーンスクリーンおよびviewport render対応を活用し、CapCutでカスタム背景を合成する  
Seedance 2.5の多言語性能向上を活かし、より良い結果を得るためにターゲット言語でpromptを入力する
